checks.name: Wake: the record waits for the first activity; one activity or one dispatched action wakes it once
Logging: plant, water, harvest, cast, bite, catch, sell, buy, place, paint, request, shell, at-rocks and evening log once each on success
Accumulators: play and panel time, a 1 s cap per step, hidden tab, 60 s idle limit, unwoken days count nothing
nextday: sleptAt and sleep, an unwoken new record with its morning row, gate 2 readable, the day-2 seedling morning with the marker and no toast
Morning table: day-3 crop rows, the day 4-6 cycle (day 7 repeats day 4), evening-again from day 4, and the context read from state
Recap: day 1 seedling; day 2 grew with the chair clause; day 3 finds-return with the pot clause; shown in the night panel
Rating and prompts: rate35 stores and keeps the night text, refuses bad input; day-3 prompts save as typed (throttled, flushed) and re-render escaped
Past midnight: Today asks how yesterday was, rate35 stores it there, and day 3 then shows the prompts on day 4
Online: no record, events, faces, resume or Menu line; recap shown; seedling still granted; no marker; stripState drops only life.days
Copy: timelineSummary34 carries the evening timeline and the days; the Menu adds one copy button only when the evening line is absent
Hygiene: no undefined or NaN on Today and night panels, the 300-event cap with dropped, one "Sleep until tomorrow" in free play and none while guided

Resume and compaction: Continue on an unwoken day adds nothing (the wake carries the time); on a woken day one resume with its wall time; without a reload, the first real input after 10 minutes of wall time with none, or the page shown again after 10 minutes hidden, logs one resume with its wall time (not after 9 minutes, nor 5 minutes hidden, never twice for one return, not for the game’s own dispatches, not online, not on an unwoken day, where the wake carries the time); after nine nights days 1-3 keep counts and prompts, 4-10 keep events
Subset pass: without the later modules the morning, the recap and the context still work; evening-again needs EVENING35

method: Actual shipped runtime with the v35 modules in Node, Three.js and glTF, the wall clock stubbed through CLOCK35. No browser, phone or audio claim.
